name: immutable-merge-no-longer-coerces-nested-plain-objects-omni-common-ui
behavioral_change: immutable 4.0.0 removed the deep coercion of the argument to `merge()`. In v_old (3.x) a plain JavaScript object passed to `Map.merge()` was recursively converted as if by `fromJS()`, so nested plain objects became `Map` instances; in v_new the argument is converted only shallowly and nested plain objects are kept as they are. The method name, arity and call form are unchanged and the returned `OrderedMap` has the same size.
downstream_effect: In the downstream project (omni-common-ui), `Sidebar._getItems` merges route sidebar configs into an `OrderedMap` and then filters with `item instanceof Map`; after the upgrade every item is a plain object, the filter removes them all, and the Sidebar renders nothing. Seven of eight failures are `TypeError: Cannot read property 'tagName' of null` with frames in react-dom, enzyme and `src/containers/Sidebar/spec.jsx`; the output never names `component.jsx` or `merge`.
reference_fix: The reference fix edits only `src/containers/Sidebar/component.jsx`, adding `fromJS` to the import on line 6 and changing `reduction.merge(value.sidebar)` on line 20 to `reduction.merge(fromJS(value.sidebar))`.
documented_in: The immutable CHANGELOG (https://github.com/immutable-js/immutable-js/blob/v4.3.9/CHANGELOG.md), section [4.0.0], BREAKING, entry for `merge()`: No longer deeply coerce argument to merge() (#1339), explaining that the argument was previously converted via `fromJS()`. Tier 2: the change is declared in prose only, with no old versus new code.
